plan.title: Descriptive treated-vs-control liver DE (no replicates)
plan.analytical_narrative: The dataset is 12,000 human liver genes x 2 samples (one treated, one control), raw salmon-derived counts, with no biological replication. Per rule R-0003@6b3a, no inferential differential expression test or p-value is possible: without within-group replication no dispersion can be estimated. The plan therefore (1) runs sample-structure QC on the variance-stabilized values, (2) pre-filters low counts, computes DESeq2 median-of-ratios size factors, and reports descriptive log2 fold changes for the treated vs control contrast (control as explicit reference level), explicitly labelled as descriptive, and (3) writes a report naming the design limitation and naming the design (e.g., >=3 replicates per group with DESeq2) that would support inference. Shrinkage and multiple-testing steps are dropped per the service answer (dropped: shrink_lfc, multiple_testing).
